answer: Make influence decay with graph distance from staked anchors. Picture the network as a meadow: each agent's grading weight is capped by the stake-weighted trust flowing to it along an atlas of attestation edges from bonded seed accounts. A sybil farm can mint a thousand identities, but they all hang off a few thin edges, so their combined weight never rises above what those edges carry. Even at the zenith of an attack, adding clones splits the same trickle of trust instead of multiplying it.
